Messages.Author: Alanmut
Messages.Body:
Hello, I have a question regarding the card *Wall of Filth*.
The text states: "Only usable before range is determined. Protean or Blood Sorcery: Put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card to prevent 2 non-aggravated damage in combat. A vampire can have only one *Wall of Filth*. Superior: Protean or Superior Blood Sorcery: As above, but to prevent 2 damage in combat."
Since it mentions preventing damage in combat without specifying a precise window, can I play the card, burn it to prevent 2 damage during that combat, and then immediately play another one? The text says a vampire can *have* only one such card, but it doesn't explicitly restrict playing only one per round or combat, right?

Messages.Author: Kilrauko
Messages.Body:
> Alanmut wrote:
> Hello, I have a question regarding the card *Wall of Filth*.
> The text states: "Only usable before range is determined. Protean or Blood Sorcery: Put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card to prevent 2 non-aggravated damage in combat. A vampire can have only one *Wall of Filth*. Superior: Protean or Superior Blood Sorcery: As above, but to prevent 2 damage in combat."
> Since it mentions preventing damage in combat without specifying a precise window, can I play the card, burn it to prevent 2 damage during that combat, and then immediately play another one? The text says a vampire can *have* only one such card, but it doesn't explicitly restrict playing only one per round or combat, right?
>
Short. No. To both as you can play more then one if opponent plays for example Outside the hourglass to deal 2 damage before range enabling you to play, burn to prevent and play another Wall-o-Filth.

Long. You cannot attempt to do what you cannot do. As there is no damage (yet) to prevent in example quoted, you cannot attempt to burn the card to prevent possible damage that might or might not be incoming depending on whether or not the opposing minion chooses their strike and/or other effects. The card does not have wording that supports it.

This is covered in  www.vekn.net/rulebook

> 5. Damage Resolution
>
> Damage resolution has two steps: prevent damage and mend damage.
>
> First, the minion taking damage can play combat cards that prevent damage. These damage prevention cards are played one at a time until all the damage is prevented or until the minion chooses not to play any more. Any unprevented damage is successfully inflicted. The damage is then mended, if the victim is a vampire, or burns life counters, if the victim is an ally or a retainer.
>
> For each point of damage successfully inflicted on a vampire, they must burn 1 blood to mend the damage. A vampire can burn all of their blood if needed, and doing so does not have any other negative effects on the vampire. If a vampire cannot mend all the damage (that is, more damage is successfully inflicted than they have blood with which to mend), they burn blood to mend what damage they can, and the unmended damage leaves them wounded.
>
> A wounded vampire goes to torpor after all remaining damage is handled (see Torpor).
>
And for attempting something you cannot do  groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/cHdOwueG71I/m/BTBYvTZhrAUJ

> > Hmmmm, I don't agree with this. I don't see why you can't do this
> > action knowing it will very likely fail.
>
> Because you can't attempt something you cannot do.
>
If you wish for cycling prevent options that allow "preloading" prevent, see Apparition, SUP Unflinching Persistence, Typhonic Beast etc. and compare their wording with Wall of Filth.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Alanmut wrote:
> Since it mentions preventing damage in combat without specifying a precise window, can I play the card, burn it to prevent 2 damage during that combat, and then immediately play another one?
>
Your scenario is unclear about when you burn the Wall of Filth (to prevent a strike? to prevent pre-range damage?). You can play Wall of Filth only "before range is determined".

> Alanmut wrote:
> The text says a vampire can *have* only one such card, but it doesn't explicitly restrict playing only one per round or combat, right?
>
Correct, it doesn't. As long as you don't have already a Wall of Filth on the vampire, you can play one "before range is determined".
